title: NBME-Style Generated Question
description: Schema for AI-generated NBME-format practice questions produced by the /nbme-gen skill

generated_date.description: ISO 8601 date the question was generated

source_concepts.description: Concept slugs from wiki/concepts/ that this question tests

source_uworld.description: UWorld question ID used for clinical context inspiration (not copied). Null if not used.

system.description: Organ system, matching wiki frontmatter convention

difficulty.description: Estimated difficulty. easy=<40% miss rate, medium=40-60%, hard=>60%

stem.description: Clinical vignette. 2-4 sentences: age, sex, presentation, PE/vitals, key objective finding. Must contain all information needed to answer. Original composition — not copied from UWorld.

lead_in.description: The question sentence. Usually included at the end of stem for display. Stored separately for programmatic use.
examples: Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in the evaluation of this patient?
Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
Which of the following best explains the mechanism of this patient's presentation?

correct_answer.description: Letter of the single correct option

explanation.description: 3-5 sentences. Why correct is correct; why each distractor is wrong. Paraphrase only.

teaching_point.description: One sentence. The highest-yield flashcard-level takeaway. Must differ from the first sentence of explanation.

distractor_rationale.description: One phrase per wrong option explaining why it is incorrect

tags.description: Always include 'step2'. Add system, topic, and concept-specific tags.

review_status.description: draft=generated, not reviewed | reviewed=human-approved | published=ready for use | needs-source=concept page insufficient | rejected=quality failure

reviewer_notes.description: Free text for human reviewer. Populated during review workflow.
